# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 097

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2400–2424, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi. Several examples had drifted to another sense or context, including `fiction`, `cluster`, `confusion`, `chase`, `sigh`, `gaze`, `curtain`, `cheek`, and `hunger`; these were aligned with the English source.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 2,425/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (27.44%); 6,412 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
